data.name: Google Sheets: Add Row
data.description: Add a single row of data to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
data.instructions:
Add a new row to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

Append a row to the specified worksheet. If the sheet has headers, column names will be available for data entry.

**Inputs:**
- {spreadsheet_id}: The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID (from the URL)
- {worksheet_id}: The worksheet/tab ID within the spreadsheet
- {has_headers}: Whether the first row contains column headers (true/false)

**Output:** {result} contains the added row confirmation.
